name: serpapi_search
description: Structured shopping and search lookup via SerpApi across engines like amazon, amazon_product, google, google_shopping, and news. Best tool for Amazon product search, ASIN lookup, bestseller/listing checks, prices, ratings, reviews, product comparisons, and finding products to buy when the user asks about Amazon items or shopping results.

engine.description: SerpApi engine. Use amazon for Amazon listing/product searches, amazon_product for a specific Amazon ASIN/product page, google_shopping for shopping comparisons, google for general web search, bing, or youtube.

query.description: Search text. For amazon this is the Amazon product/listing query (maps to 'k'); for most others it maps to 'q'. Good for product names, shopping phrases, bestseller/category searches, and buyer-intent queries like 'best weather station under 300'.

asin.description: Amazon ASIN for a specific product detail lookup. Best with engine=amazon_product when you want one exact listing.

amazon_domain.description: Amazon domain for amazon engines (default: amazon.com). Example: amazon.co.uk

language.description: Locale for engines that support it (default: en_US).

device.description: desktop, mobile, or tablet. Default: desktop.

num_results.description: How many normalized results to return (1-10, default: 5).

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for fresh fetch.

optimize_query.description: For engine=amazon, refine conversational input into a compact search query before first request (default: true).

extra_params.description: Additional engine-specific query parameters passed through to SerpApi.

include_raw.description: If true, include full raw SerpApi payload in data.raw (large).
